title: First AI test, OSO vs traditional

design.question: For the same money, does an OSO community of AI labs solve more targets than a traditional one?
design.fixed: the same 4 labs, $0.4 each, no personas

answer: Both communities solved 4 targets for the same money.
caveats: One run per side: no verdict either way.
One OSO run stopped partway and was rerun from the start.
